claim: Decode GEMV is bandwidth-bound. 4-bit weights move 4x fewer bytes than fp16, so wall-clock speedup vs fp16 GEMV should approach 4x, minus dequantization overhead.

arithmetic_intensity.note: Each weight is read once and used in one multiply-add (2 FLOPs). fp16 is 2 bytes; 4-bit is 0.5 bytes.

distance_from_ridge: W4 GEMV at batch 1 sits at 4 FLOP/byte, 60x to 65x below the ridge on T4 and A100. Decode is not close to compute-bound.
predicted_residual: Missing factor vs 4x attributed to dequant instruction overhead (nibble extract, sign-extend, scale fma) plus imperfect HBM saturation. Expect measured ~3.0x to 3.4x.

predicted_crossover_batch.meaning: Batch size where SM throughput % crosses DRAM throughput %. That is where decode stops being memory-bound.
